scholarships.name: Research Grants in Germany **• DAAD**
scholarships.description: The research grant offers the opportunity to realise a research project in Germany. The programme sup-ports research stays during a doctorate or in the early postdoc phase.
scholarships.deadlineText: Application deadlines are updated annually in the second quarter. In most cases, they are in the same period as the previous year. You can find the current dates here:
scholarships.sourceQuote: You can apply if you: are doing your doctorate at a university or research institution outside Germany or have already completed your doctorate (post-doc, up to 4 years after completing your doctorate) You cannot apply if you are doing your entire doctorate at a German university.

eligibility.sourceQuote:
You can apply if you:  

  * are doing your doctorate at a university or research institution outside Germany or
  * have already completed your doctorate (post-doc, up to 4 years after completing your doctorate)
You cannot apply if you are doing your entire doctorate at a German university.

eligibility.textValue: Resident in Germany longer than 15 months at the application deadline is not allowed.
eligibility.sourceQuote: * Your application **cannot** be considered, if you have been resident in Germany for longer than 15 months at the application deadline.

applicability.sourceQuote: The research grant offers the opportunity to realise a research project in Germany.
